purpose: Each mutation is a minimal repair of one weakness. It is applied alone to a pristine copy of the subject file. The named tests must then FAIL, which shows they discriminate the weakness rather than passing regardless. A mutation is not a proposed patch for NTI.

mutations.repair: require a request signature by the key registered for the actor
accept an air-gap bundle only from a signer known to the registry
count token uses across committed batches as well as the pending buffer
reject an amount that is not a non-negative integer
component-wise prefix match and reject parent-directory components
compare the persisted last_batch_hash with the recomputed batch-chain head
bind the token to the requesting actor
bind the token to one call identity
fail closed when a revocation notice exists, whatever its signature
promote the odd node unchanged instead of duplicating it
